how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-darkshore-03.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:986:obj:0: Find 5 Fine Moonstalker Pelts and return them to Terenthis in Auberdine.
rows.quest:986:details:0: ⟦1⟧, your skills have already helped me in my endeavor. Could I impose on you again to help ⟦E1⟧ and his master Volcor? In addition, I can craft you a magical cloak that will allow you to walk unhindered by ⟦E2⟧'s creatures while you look for him.
rows.quest:986:details:1: To create the cloak, I'll need five fine moonstalker pelts from a moonstalker sire or matriarch to have enough material. The cats can be found near Wildbend River to the south, or even farther south near ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:986:progress:0: I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.
rows.quest:986:completion:0: These will do nicely, ⟦2⟧. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.
rows.quest:986:completion:1: Give me a few moments, then return to me.
rows.quest:986:completion:2: Oh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could ⟦E4⟧ the illusion.
rows.quest:993:obj:0: Find Volcor in ⟦E2⟧ and give him the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:993:details:0: The cloak is complete, ⟦3⟧. The time has come to find Volcor. I can only hope we are in time.
rows.quest:993:details:1: The cloak's magic, once invoked, will not last long; perhaps five minutes. It will be up to you to know when to use it: I would suggest waiting until you find ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:993:details:2: If what he has told me is true, you will find his master in a cave south of here. ⟦E1⟧ will be alongside the road waiting for you. Signal to him by waving when you see him, and he'll point the way towards his master.
rows.quest:993:completion:0: Wonderful! Terenthis found someone to help me.
rows.quest:993:completion:1: And look. a moonstalker cloak...⟦4⟧ Oh... that hurts. Thank you, ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:993:completion:2: The furbolgs wounded me before I managed to evade them. Give me a moment, and I should be fine to talk some more.
rows.quest:995:obj:0: Escape the Furbolg cave and meet Terenthis in Auberdine.
rows.quest:995:details:0: All right then... if you're sure, we'll sneak out of here. Let us leave when you're ready.
rows.quest:995:details:1: Remember, after you've escaped, meet Terenthis back in Auberdine. I'll head there on my own since I'll probably be moving faster than you.
rows.quest:995:completion:0: ⟦7⟧! I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in ⟦E2⟧ and beyond.
rows.quest:1133:obj:0: Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.
rows.quest:1133:details:0: If you're fresh off the boat from Menethil, then the first thing you should do is... go to Astranaar. I'm sure an eager member of the ⟦E6⟧ such as you can do some real good there. Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire and offer your services.
rows.quest:1133:details:1: But don't bother mentioning who sent you. Shindrell does not know me...
rows.quest:1133:completion:0: You are here to offer your services to the ⟦E6⟧, ⟦8⟧? We welcome the aid, for although its beauty remains... ⟦E3⟧ Forest is not the peaceful place it once was.
rows.quest:2078:obj:0: Find Gelkak's First Mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, and lead it back to Gelkak.
rows.quest:2078:details:0: Landlubber, ye needs to find me first mate.
rows.quest:2078:details:1: Take this'n key, puts it in his gulliver an' bring him back here to serve the Cap'n.
rows.quest:2078:details:2: Them murlocs an' their chief ain't gonna be too happy once me first mate gets a hold of em!
rows.quest:2078:progress:0: Where be me first mate, ⟦9⟧? Shackles n' sharks fer ye soon if ye don't hurry!
rows.quest:2078:completion:0: Yarrr... Ye be provin' yerself to be more than a yella sea dog, landlubber.
rows.quest:2078:completion:1: The Cap'n may promote ye to poop deck swabby if ye be keepin' this up...
rows.quest:2098:obj:0: Find and return the three pieces of Gelkak's ⟦E7⟧ to Gelkak Gyromast.
rows.quest:2098:details:0: A pirate's life ain't an easy one, landlubber. It ain't all about plunderin' and booze! Alas, me ship be sunk just off shore thanks to them pesky Threshadons.
rows.quest:2098:details:1: What I be needin' is me first mate back in workin' order!
rows.quest:2098:details:2: When I washed up'n shore, the key for me first mate broke on the rocks and was pilfered by the beasties of ⟦E2⟧. Out of the corner of me eyes I saw some of them Ragin' Crawlers, Ferocious Foreststrider, and murloc rummaging through the wreckage....
rows.quest:2098:progress:0: Have ye found me broke down key, landlubber?
rows.quest:2098:completion:0: Avast ye scurvy sea dog! Ye did it! Soon me first mate be back in workin' order and them beasties won't know what ⟦E8⟧ em!
rows.quest:2098:completion:1: Hrm, have ye seen me first mate?
rows.quest:5321:obj:0: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5321:details:0: I was on my way to Maestra's Post to meet Liladris Moonriver, but I decided to stop here and take a short nap. Ever since I awoke from the emerald dream, I have been so sleepy...
rows.quest:5321:details:2: Would you mind showing me the way? I understand that Maestra's Post is south of here, along the road in ⟦E3⟧. It can be dangerous, so I hope you have some friends that will join us.
rows.quest:5321:details:3: Lastly, I may fall asleep so if you ever need to wake me, please use my horn. You'll find it in the chest here.
rows.quest:5321:completion:0: Oh, I am so happy Kerlonian made it! And I'm sure I'll find him sleeping somewhere around here, won't I?
rows.quest:5321:completion:1: Thank you for showing him the way, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:970:obj:0: Collect a ⟦E9⟧ and return it to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
rows.quest:970:details:0: Balthule's letter is dire. This Cult of the Dark Strand is a thorn in my side that must be removed. I have been dealing with some of the Dark Strand scum northeast of here at Ordil'Aran. One of their number possesses a soul gem that I believe holds the secret to the cult's power.
rows.quest:970:details:1: Bring it to me, and I will be able to decipher the secrets held within.
rows.quest:970:progress:0: Have you acquired that soul gem?
rows.quest:970:completion:0: Hmm, some dark magic enchants this soulstone. Let's see what's trapped inside, shall we?
rows.quest:994:obj:0: Protect Volcor until you reach the road, then speak to Terenthis in Auberdine.
rows.quest:994:details:0: All right, ⟦12⟧, force it is. Let's get out of here as soon as you're ready. We'll fight our way down to the road--⟦E1⟧ should still be there. Once there, we can part ways.
rows.quest:994:details:1: Terenthis will want to hear your version of the story immediately, so head to Auberdine after we make it out of here.
rows.quest:994:completion:0: ⟦13⟧! I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in ⟦E2⟧ and beyond.
rows.quest:943:obj:0: Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil ⟦E10⟧ wants you to bring him the ⟦E11⟧ and ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:943:details:0: Prospector Whelgar now holds the original fossil at his site in the ⟦E13⟧. When I discovered the ⟦E11⟧, I believed it to be the key to unlocking the mystery of the fossil.
rows.quest:943:details:1: While I traveled on the road to meet Whelgar, I was attacked by raptors and the relic was lost. I don't know which one of the mottled beasts swallowed the relic but if you can retrieve it, I can unleash the power of these artifacts.
rows.quest:943:details:2: Bring me both the ⟦E11⟧, and the original fossil he holds.
rows.quest:943:progress:0: With the ⟦E11⟧ I will be able to release the hidden secrets of my fossil as well as Remtravel's fossil from ⟦E2⟧, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:943:completion:1: Now to see if I can use the stone to decipher the powers of the fossils.
rows.quest:973:obj:0: Bring ⟦E14⟧ to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
rows.quest:973:details:0: Ilkrud Magthrull. Yes, I have knowledge of him. He is a powerful orc warlock that makes his residence at the ⟦E15⟧ Scar Shrine, a place of great evil in southwestern ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:973:details:1: He had been little more than an annoyance until now, and I had not dealt with him, but it seems that his time has come.
rows.quest:973:progress:0: You look a bit shaken up, ⟦16⟧. Are you well?
rows.quest:973:completion:0: It was a grand thing you did today, ⟦17⟧. You should be quite proud of yourself for having faced down a warlock of such power.
rows.quest:973:completion:1: Now, let's see what we can learn from Ilkrud's writings.
rows.quest:1140:obj:0: Free the trapped Highborne souls in Night Run and Satyrnaar, then return to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
rows.quest:1140:details:0: The writing of the orcs is little better than the scribblings of a child. Many of my order scoffed when I chose to learn their tongue, but I have found it beneficial to gain further understanding of my ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1140:details:1: From Ilkrud's scribblings, it appears that Athrikus still possesses two soulgems, and they are being held in Night Run and Satyrnaar, satyr-held areas in northeast ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1140:details:2: Be careful out there, ⟦18⟧, the satyrs' blood-soaked temples can be unsettling even for a seasoned ⟦19⟧ such as yourself.
rows.quest:1140:progress:0: I heard whisper once that the satyrs' history is somehow related to that of the night elves, but I have found my esteemed hosts reticent to speak of the matter.
rows.quest:1140:completion:0: Perhaps the satyrs have been allowed to persist in the forest for too long. I will speak with Elissa about it when next I travel to Auberdine.
rows.quest:1140:completion:1: Nonetheless, with the soulgems destroyed, Athrikus' power will be greatly diminished. We must seize on this opportunity to eliminate him and his cult.
rows.quest:1167:obj:0: Speak with Balthule ⟦E17⟧ near the Tower of Althalaxx.
rows.quest:1167:details:0: Before confronting Athrikus, it would probably be wise for you to consult with Balthule. I have no doubt he has been vigilant in his watch of the Tower, and he may have information about recent developments.
rows.quest:1167:completion:0: Ah, it's good to see you again, ⟦20⟧! The strangest things have been happening around here, I'm glad you showed up!
rows.quest:1167:completion:1: It was very strange, ⟦21⟧. Everything seemed normal--well, as normal as things get around here--and then suddenly there was a blinding flash of light from the upper room of the tower. Then came the screams. The cries split the air, and lightning struck the ground from time to time. What's going on?
rows.quest:981:obj:0: Talk to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
rows.quest:981:details:0: For all the work that you have done, you deserve to be well rewarded. Return to Delgren and tell him that Athrikus Narassin lies stilled by your hand, and the Cult of the Dark Strand is beaten and scattered.
rows.quest:981:completion:0: I knew you would be up to the task, ⟦22⟧.
rows.quest:981:completion:1: I sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many of the wrongs that plague our lands. Bear my blessings, ⟦23⟧, as well as this gift.
rows.quest:1143:obj:0: Kill Athrikus Narassin and bring his head to Balthule ⟦E17⟧ near the Tower of Althalaxx.
rows.quest:1143:details:0: I see. Well, if what you say is true, then now is the time to ⟦E18⟧. I believe Athrikus resides at the top of the tower. Be careful though, he is surrounded by many powerful warlocks, much more deadly than the ones you faced before.
rows.quest:1143:progress:0: Athrikus Narassin is an ancient and powerful warlock. Perhaps we should wait for Delgren's assistance, but he obviously had much faith in you to send you alone.
rows.quest:1143:completion:0: With the death of Athrikus, I hope that the demonic forces in this area will be driven back. I have no doubt that they will regroup and return, but then we shall be even more prepared to meet their ⟦E19⟧.
